name: Rajasthan Tube Manufacturing Company Limited
about: Rajasthan Tube Manufacturing Company Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells steel tubes and pipes in India. The company offers black and galvanized ERW steel tubes and pipes that are used in various applications, such as, water mains and sewerage systems, agriculture and irrigation, tube-wells, natural gas, LPG and oil refinery piping. It also provides hot rolled steel sheets for making tubular products, including hot rolled coils, pipes, LPG cylinders, and shuttering plates. In addition, the company's hot rolled steel sheets are used as a component in pressure vessels, building ship hull and automobile suspensions. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India.
